authors: experiment-director (machine-readable record of PROTOCOL.md, no design change)

links.note: research/isogeny_class_ic_yield_20261102/p2_prime_analogues/PROTOCOL.md is the narrative; this file records it. Route recorded here is the local fallback frozen by the director on 2026-11-02 because the isolab-eks route could not be used from the submitting host (see the director report and cards); an EKS run needs an amendment first (execution, rounds >= 5, a control arm in every cell, a curve-shard selector).

question: Inside one isogeny class whose Frobenius order is the maximal order (conductor 1, one crater, one prime order n), do the index-calculus yield, relations-phase work and online time per decomposition attempt of the repository's prime-abscissa mitm pipeline differ between curves, beyond what the A/A, isomorphic-model and planted-20-percent controls show?

claims.text: In each enumerated class (D, h, p, n) the yield of the prime-abscissa mitm pipeline at m and |F| = N has curve share of variance (ICC) at most U (95 percent two-level bootstrap bound), a max/min curve ratio R against an A/A spread S, and the detector finds a planted 20 percent curve effect with power P.
claims.if_supported: null supported in that cell (closed lead for the pipeline on that scaled analogue); only when the planted-effect power is at least 0.9 in that cell
claims.if_not_supported: curve effect suspected when p < 0.0025 and the effect exceeds the isomorphic-model control, which triggers a follow-up protocol, not a claim; otherwise inconclusive with the numbers reported

claims.text: No result states anything about ECCp-131 (different trace, class number and size), security, speed, or an improvement over the index-calculus baseline; no rho reference or section 5a band applies because one method is compared across curves of one class.

hypotheses.statement: Within one isogeny class of conductor 1 the yield of the prime-abscissa mitm pipeline has no curve effect: the curve share of variance is indistinguishable from zero and the max/min curve ratio lies inside its permutation null.
hypotheses.mechanism: Curves of one class share p, n and the factor-base size rule; only transport cost, automorphisms and the smallest-abscissa presentation can differ.

predictions.minimum_effect: yield ICC permutation p >= 0.0025 (Bonferroni over 10 classes x 2 values of m), max |z| and max/min inside the permutation null q95, isomorphic-model RMS log ratio of the order of the A/A round-halves spread, and positive-control power >= 0.9 in the cell

data_seen.measured: 24-bit class A harness check on 12 curves and 4 iso pairs at isolation L1; not data of this protocol
one-curve timing and yield per size; used only to size attempt counts and cost

arms.description: ic.pipeline, factor_base prime-abscissa:size=N (N = min(N_y, 1448)), oracle mitm:m=2 or m=3, linalg incremental-gauss-full-rank, max_trials A (identical on every curve of a class)

the identical method on the identical seeds; present at 24 and 28 bits, dropped at 32 bits and above (deterministic duplicate); counted-metric A/A at every size is the round-parity split of the main arm
factor base N' = round(N * 1.2^(1/m)): expected yield 1.2 times main, a planted 20 percent effect on the same curves and seeds

positive.expected_detection: p2tool analyze substitutes the pc cells of one curve at a time into the main data (200 random choices) and reports the fraction flagged at the 95th percentile of the unplanted permutation null by the ICC, max |z| and max/min detectors; a null is informative only if the power of every detector is at least 0.9 in that class and m

negative.not_applicable_reason: PROTOCOL.md section 4: the null distribution of every statistic is generated by permuting the cells of a class across its curves (2000 permutations, analysis seed 20261102, add-one resolution 1/2001 < 0.0025); no separate random-curve population exists by design because an unrelated curve of the same size has a different n and N and would add a factor, not remove one

independent.name: curve
levels: the h Hilbert-root curves of one class (h = 128 for class A, 300 for class B), plus 8 u-scaled isomorphic models per class

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: one ecbench binary and one p2tool binary per run, SHA-256 recorded per row (binary_sha256) and in the card receipt

factors.name: host_and_isolation
factors.how: isolation level, steal, PSI and run queue recorded per row; counted metrics do not depend on the level; the clock metric is descriptive unless the row is L2

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: ecbench order alternate, 4 balanced rounds, 1 warm-up discarded

factors.name: algorithm_seed
factors.how: one seed per (workload, round) derived by ecbench from measurement.seed 103 and the workload id, shared by the arms of that round, different across rounds and targets

factors.name: target
factors.value: 4 targets per curve (8 for m = 3 at 24 bits), target_seed 20261102

factors.name: factor_base_size_and_attempts
factors.how: N and A are functions of (n, m, cap) only and identical on every curve of a class; the pc arm differs on purpose

factors.name: size_D_h
factors.value: sizes 24, 28, 32 bits run under amendment A1 (36 and 40 bits deferred, not dropped, no data taken); D fixed across sizes; class A (D = -84171, h = 128) and class B (D = -414651, h = 300)
factors.how: six run classes of the ten listed in classes.json; the other four (c36A, c36B, c40A, c40B) are deferred

factors.name: model_presentation
factors.how: 8 curves per class re-presented by a seeded u-scaling; reported as the iso-model RMS log ratio

factors.name: relations_per_run_R
factors.value: R = min(100, 0.6 N); the 40-bit reduced plan (R = 30, --relations 30) applies only if the deferred 40-bit cells are later run
factors.how: spec generator rule; the 40-bit cells report their own measured power

seed_derivation.note: ecbench derives one algorithm seed per (workload, round) from measurement.seed 103; target_seed 20261102; iso u from a seeded SHA-256 stream; analysis seed 20261102; no seed chosen after a look

instance_sampling.rule: every curve of the class (all h Hilbert roots), enumerated completely by construction, not by a walk or a sample

blinding.how: arm roles main, aa and pc are fixed by the protocol; the only arm contrast is the frozen pc substitution, so no free contrast exists to bias; analysis is the frozen p2tool binary with no hand selection of cells

power.note: instances = 1332 curve models per m over the six run classes (3 sizes x (128 + 8 and 300 + 8) = 3 x 444; the v1 figure 444 was the per-size count, v2 states the count of the run scope); replicates = 4 rounds x 4 targets per curve (m = 3 at 24 bits: 4 x 8); family stays the preregistered yield ICC permutation p over 10 classes x 2 values of m = 20 tests, Bonferroni 0.05/20 = 0.0025, unchanged by amendment A1 (8 of the 20 tests are deferred, not run; keeping the divisor 20 is the more conservative choice); add-one permutation p resolution 1/2001 < 0.0025; power against a planted 20 percent effect is measured per cell by the pc substitution and a cell below 0.9 is reported as not informative at 20 percent, never as a null

preflight_runtime.measured_on: research/isogeny_class_ic_yield_20261102/p2_prime_analogues/calibration/calibration.md and README.md cost table on the 4-core builder host under load average 5 to 7: fixed = harness overhead per run (0.17 s), per sample = the largest measured per-run process wall of the run scope (32 bits, m = 2: 0.7 s); total = README cost table summed over the 12 run cells = (0.45+1.05+0.85+2.0) + (1.4+3.4+0.7+1.6) + (1.2+2.9+0.95+2.2) = 18.7 CPU-hours = 67320 s, single host, one cell at a time; the 36- and 40-bit cells (v1 total 388800 s) are deferred

primary.name: yield per attempt
primary.definition: relations_found / targets_tried of one cell (curve, round, target); an attempt is one increment of targets_tried, a relation one increment of relations_found; every run is exactly A attempts
primary.source: session records.jsonl counters relations_found and targets_tried

secondary.name: relations-phase GAE per attempt
secondary.definition: relations-phase GAE / attempts of one cell

secondary.name: online wall per attempt
secondary.definition: online.wall_ns / attempts of one cell; descriptive unless the row is L2 and read only against the in-session A/A interval

secondary.name: oracle setup GAE per run
secondary.definition: oracle_setup phase GAE of one run, reported per curve and not tested

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The primary metric is the counted yield, independent of the isolation level; the clock metric is secondary and descriptive unless a row is L2.

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design, amended by A1: every curve of each of the six run classes (c24A, c24B, c28A, c28B, c32A, c32B) x m in {2, 3} x targets x (rounds + 1 warm-up) x arms, as written by p2tool spec with rounds 4, --targets 4 (8 for m = 3 at 24 bits) and --aa 1 at 24 and 28 bits, --aa 0 at 32 bits; then stop. The cells of c36A, c36B, c40A, c40B for m = 2 and 3 are deferred: no data are taken under this protocol version, and they stay in the preregistered population (reported as not run, never filled)

every run ends exhausted after exactly A attempts; outcome status exhausted is not a failure; a session whose in-session A/A relation counts are not identical is invalid; a cell that does not complete is reported as not run, never filled

invalidation_rules: an A/A pair of relation counts that is not identical invalidates the session
a clock of a preempted, resumed or non-L2 row is descriptive only; counted yield remains
a cell with planted-effect power below 0.9 is reported as not informative at 20 percent

decision_rule.text: Null supported in a cell: yield ICC permutation p >= 0.0025 (bootstrap upper bound of the ICC reported), max |z| and max/min inside their null q95 (or p >= 0.0025), iso RMS log ratio of the order of the A/A spread, and positive-control power >= 0.9. Curve effect suspected: p < 0.0025 for the yield ICC (or max |z|) and the effect exceeds the iso control; it triggers a follow-up protocol (fresh seeds, then test n, smallest-abscissa structure or CM field), not a claim. Everything else: inconclusive, numbers reported.
decision_rule.threshold: yield ICC permutation p < 0.0025 (Bonferroni 0.05/20); positive-control power >= 0.9
decision_rule.statistic: unbalanced one-way random-effects ANOVA ICC of yield per class and m, with max/min of per-curve means and max |z| as companions
decision_rule.interval: one-sided 95 percent percentile of a two-level bootstrap (curves with replacement, cells within drawn curves, 2000 resamples, clipped at 0); permutation p over 2000 cell permutations
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: ICC upper bound, max/min curve ratio against the A/A round-halves spread

graphs: per class and m: per-curve yield with the A/A and iso bands
planted-effect power per detector and cell

inadmissible: reading any result as a statement about ECCp-131, security or speed
ranking curves of one class by a clock below L2
dropping or filling a cell that did not run
changing N, A, R, targets, rounds, thresholds or seeds after seeing results
treating a null from a cell with positive-control power below 0.9 as a null

literature.claim: within an isogeny class only transport cost, automorphisms and model presentation can differ

amendments.reason: Owner decision relayed by the main session on 2026-11-02: the isolab-eks route could not be used from the submitting host, so run the local fallback at reduced scope. Run cells c24A, c24B, c28A, c28B, c32A, c32B for m = 2 and m = 3 (12 cells); defer the 36- and 40-bit cells. Isolation L0 on this host is accepted: counted metrics (yield, GAE) are exact, wall-clock is descriptive only. No data of this protocol has been taken: p2_prime_analogues/runs does not exist; smoke/ and calibration/ are harness and sizing checks, not data.
changes: Run scope: the 12 cells c24A, c24B, c28A, c28B, c32A, c32B x m in {2, 3}; the 8 cells c36A, c36B, c40A, c40B x m in {2, 3} are deferred: recorded as not run, no data taken, not dropped from the protocol population.

Route: execution.backend local, measurement.isolation_required L0 (both already recorded in v1), one cell at a time under the ecbench host lock, smallest cell first; ecbench verify --replay 12 (REPLAYS=12); card timeouts are 2 x the README per-cell estimate; ecbench and p2tool are built in a dedicated git worktree pinned to the commit that files this amendment.
Clock metric (online_wall_ns_per_attempt) is descriptive only at L0; the counted metrics (yield, rel_gae_per_attempt, oracle_setup_gae) are exact and are the only ones that decide.
Decision rule unchanged: the multiplicity family stays 20 tests with Bonferroni alpha 0.0025; the 8 deferred tests are not run and are not removed from the divisor.
